explanation: Two 20-mass bodies start ~1.12 apart and fall toward each other while light bodies add strong nearby forces. With large dt=1/30 the 6 adaptive substeps per outer step are insufficient as separation shrinks to 0.95 at step 1 then 0.56 at step 2 and speeds reach ~10; leapfrog energy error accumulates (~6 at step1 then ~108 by step2) exceeding the 2% tolerance. Reducing only dt to 0.001 keeps energy constant, confirming temporal resolution / substepping insufficiency during the close heavy-body encounter.
